name: Iconium
overview: The city of Iconium is a significant setting in the early ministry of the Apostle Paul, where he and his companion boldly preached the gospel in the synagogue, resulting in many Jews and Greeks coming to faith. Despite the success, Paul faced strong opposition as unbelieving Jews incited Gentiles against the believers, causing division within the city. The apostles remained steadfast, performing signs and wonders as confirmation of God's grace, even in the face of violent persecution attempts by both Gentiles and Jews.
